title: Northgate Protect Cancellation and Refund Terms by Tier
content:
These are the per-tier cancellation and refund terms of Northgate Protect plans: the full-refund window, the basis of a refund outside it, the cancellation fee and its cap, whether a refund follows a settled claim, the refund when the covered item is returned, and the rounding of a prorated refund.

| Term | Standard 2-Year | Standard 3-Year | Accident 2-Year | Accident 3-Year | Accident 4-Year | Complete Monthly |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Calendar days after plan purchase or enrollment for a full refund when no claim has been filed | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Basis of a refund outside that window | Unused days | Unused days | Unused days | Unused days | Unused days | Current month not refunded |
| Cancellation fee, percent of the plan price | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 0 |
| Most charged as a cancellation fee | $25.00 | $25.00 | $25.00 | $25.00 | $25.00 | $0.00 |
| Cancellation refund paid after a replacement or reimbursement settlement | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Refund when the covered item is returned to Northgate | Full plan price | Full plan price | Full plan price | Full plan price | Full plan price | Not applicable |
| Rounding of a prorated refund | Down to the cent | Down to the cent | Down to the cent | Down to the cent | Down to the cent | Down to the cent |

## Terms explained

- **Unused days:** the refund is the price in proportion to the coverage days remaining out of the total coverage days.
- **Current month not refunded:** no refund is paid for the month already charged.
- **Cancellation fee:** the lesser of the fee percentage of the plan price and the fee cap, applied to prorated refunds.
- *Hypothetical:* on a one-time plan priced $90.00, 10 percent is $9.00, below the $25.00 cap, so the fee is $9.00; on a plan priced $400.00, 10 percent is $40.00 and the cap of $25.00 applies.
